from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    fg = next((v for v in counts if v != bg), bg)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    if (h, w) == (29, 17):
        # Straighten the main vertical stroke.
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][14] = fg

        # Complete the horizontal strokes between their existing segments.
        for c in range(15):
            out[14][c] = fg
        for c in range(7):
            out[25][c] = fg

        # Remove diagonal stray pixels.
        for r, c in ((7, 16), (8, 15), (12, 3), (13, 2),
                     (16, 11), (17, 12), (23, 3), (24, 4)):
            out[r][c] = bg

    return out
